Name: Simple Storage Terminal 2 (New Update)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b]Simple Storage Terminal[/b]
Connect up to eight chests and access their contents from one convenient menu. Search, filter, sort, transfer items, and add a Workbench to craft using your connected storage.
Your items stay in their actual chests.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Combined storage:[/b] View up to eight connected chests together.[/*]
[*][b]Category dropdown:[/b] Filter crops and seeds, fish, materials, tools, or furniture and machines.[/*]
[*][b]Search options:[/b] Highlight matches or hide nonmatching items.[/*]
[*][b]Sort dropdown:[/b] Choose Stardew order, alphabetical order, or quantity.[/*]
[*][b]Transfer controls:[/b] Move a stack, one item, or a custom quantity.[/*]
[*][b]Quick Deposit:[/b] Store matching item types already present in your connected chests.[/*]
[*][b]Adjustable menu size:[/b] Choose Standard, Large, or Fit Screen through optional GMCM.[/*]
[*][b]Remember your view:[/b] Keep your search, category filter, and scroll position between visits during the current game session.[/*]
[*][b]Connection summary:[/b] Check connection rules and unsupported chests touching your network.[/*]
[*][b]Controller support and all 12 built-in game languages.[/b][/*]
[/list][heading]Getting started[/heading]
Buy the Storage Terminal recipe from Robin at Farming level 6 for [b]10,000g[/b].
Crafting materials:
[list]
[*]50 Wood[/*]
[*]5 Iron Bars[/*]
[*]1 Refined Quartz[/*]
[*]1 Battery Pack[/*]
[/list]Place the terminal beside your chests and interact with it.
Chests must touch the terminal or another connected chest horizontally or vertically. Diagonal connections and gaps do not count.
[heading]Bigger Terminal[/heading]
The starter terminal supports ordinary wooden and stone chests.
Connect a placed starter terminal to exactly eight ordinary chests. Robin will send a letter the following morning, unlocking the Bigger Terminal Upgrade.
You can buy the finished upgrade for [b]50,000g[/b], or buy its recipe for [b]10,000g[/b] and craft it with:
[list]
[*]1,000 Wood[/*]
[*]5 Gold Bars[/*]
[*]2 Iridium Bars[/*]
[*]2 Battery Packs[/*]
[/list]Hold the upgrade and interact with your placed starter terminal.
The Bigger Terminal supports ordinary chests, Big Chests, Big Stone Chests, and supported expanded chests from [b]Simple Chest Upgrade[/b]. The maximum remains eight connected chests.
[heading]Workshop crafting[/heading]
Hold a vanilla [b]Workbench[/b] and interact with a placed terminal. Confirm to install it and unlock the Craft button.
[list]
[*]Craft using your backpack and connected chest ingredients.[/*]
[*]Crafted items go into your backpack.[/*]
[*]Each terminal receives its own Workshop upgrade.[/*]
[*]Workshop terminals display a gold [b]W badge[/b] in the world and inventory.[/*]
[*]Their tooltip identifies the installed Workshop.[/*]
[*]Workshop terminals stay separate from ordinary terminals when stacking.[/*]
[*]Installed upgrades and terminal settings are preserved during native tool pickup.[/*]
[/list]Optional Simple Pouch ingredients require crafting to be enabled in both mods. This integration is off by default.
[heading]Permanent remote access[/heading]
After connecting a Bigger Terminal to exactly eight supported chests and receiving Robin’s next-morning letter, the host can buy permanent remote access for [b]5,000,000g[/b].
The remote appears as a shortcut beside the inventory menu and does not occupy a backpack slot.
Pair it with one Bigger Terminal to access that storage remotely. Remote crafting is available when the paired terminal has a Workshop installed.
After moving the paired terminal, pair it again.
[heading]Controls[/heading]
[b]Mouse and keyboard[/b]
[list]
[*]Click an item to transfer the selected quantity.[/*]
[*]Right-click to transfer one.[/*]
[*]Click category or sort buttons to open their dropdowns.[/*]
[*]Use the mouse wheel to navigate dropdown choices or scroll inventories.[/*]
[*]Press [b]F[/b] to focus search.[/*]
[*]Press [b]Escape[/b] to close a dropdown or menu.[/*]
[/list][b]Controller[/b]
[list]
[*]Navigate with the directional controls.[/*]
[*]Press [b]A[/b] to select or transfer.[/*]
[*]Press [b]X[/b] to transfer one.[/*]
[*]Press [b]Y[/b] for Quick Deposit.[/*]
[*]Use shoulder buttons to change storage pages.[/*]
[*]Press [b]Back[/b] for text entry; focus the custom quantity field to enter an amount.[/*]
[*]Press [b]B[/b] to close.[/*]
[/list]Clicking outside a dropdown dismisses it without transferring the item underneath.
[heading]Optional settings[/heading]
With [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], you can:
[list]
[*]Choose Standard, Large, or Fit Screen.[/*]
[*]Enable or disable remembered views.[/*]
[*]Enable optional Simple Pouch crafting ingredients.[/*]
[/list]Expanded layouts may cause sizing or overlap issues with other UI mods or high UI-scale settings. Choose Standard if the controls do not fit comfortably.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*]Supports 36-, 48-, and 60-slot backpacks with adaptive layouts.[/*]
[*]Uses native chest inventories, allowing Automate to work with the stored items.[/*]
[*]Supports multiplayer; everyone should install the same version.[/*]
[*]Simple Chest Upgrade and Simple Pouch are optional.[/*]
[*]Fridges, Junimo storage, shipping bins, and unrelated custom chest types are not connected.[/*]
[*]Sorting changes the displayed order, not the physical arrangement inside your chests.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation and updating[/heading]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/b].
[list=1]
[*]Close the game.[/*]
[*]Install the included [b]SimpleTerminal[/b] folder inside your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]When updating, replace the previous terminal mod folder and retain your existing config.json.[/*]
[*]Keep only one version installed, then restart the game.[/*]
[/list]The installation folder remains [b]SimpleTerminal[/b] for compatibility. Existing internal IDs, learned recipes, and chest contents are preserved.
